content: Third distinct Cowork upload failure mode found for this plugin, each only surfaced by actually attempting the real upload rather than reasoning about the format in the abstract: missing .claude-plugin/plugin.json, backslash zip paths, and now an agent name derived from a dotted filename. Cowork derives an agent's name from its file's basename, so any '.'-bearing agent filename (the '<role>.agent.md' convention used here) is invalid outside the literal '.md' suffix. Renamed to a bare '<role>.md' pattern and added an explicit frontmatter 'name' field as a hedge against relying on filename-derivation alone. The command/run/reject '<verb>.<name>.asset.md' asset-file convention is unaffected — it's assets, not agents, and wasn't flagged.

next_seed.summary: If any future agent file is added to any plugin in this repo, name it '<role>.md' (or another hyphen/alphanumeric-only basename), never '<role>.<anything>.md' — this is now a load-bearing constraint on the agent-file naming convention, not just an orchestrator-specific fix.
